capabilities: Display notes as a kanban board grouped by a property
Drag cards between columns to update the status property
Color cards and columns automatically from emoji-prefixed property values
Switch a card's status via an on-card dropdown
Group cards on two axes with swimlanes and a masonry card-wall mode
extras: Not in the official community plugin store; must be installed via BRAT. README documents that it makes no network requests and explains a 'Vault Enumeration' safety-scan flag caused by its status rename/recolor command scanning vault frontmatter.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of Kanban Bases View by I. Welch Canavan (MIT), adding a Traditional Chinese UI, status-based card colors
problem: Obsidian's Bases has no kanban view with whole-card color coding, in-place status switching, adjustable columns, or two-axis swimlane grouping.

relations.evidence: Forked from Kanban Bases View by I. Welch Canavan (MIT).
if you use the Metadata Menu plugin, to its select menus

summary: Bases view that renders notes as a kanban board with emoji-based card coloring, on-card status switching, swimlanes, a masonry mode, and a Traditional Chinese UI.
